name: Lucky Daye
notes: The lane's funk-and-live-band wing, and one of the volume's three declared boundary cases with `neo-soul`; it is kept in `trap-soul` because "his rhythm programming and radio context are 2019+ R&B", which is the volume's own reasoning and is repeated here so a reviewer can move it knowingly. ⛔ **`bass808` is null:** "played electric bass with walking motion on the album material; sub-808 only on the radio-facing remixes. This inverts the lane's default low end." So the low end is a real `bassline` at `independent_riff` with the widest passing-tone set in this batch. The harmony is the entry's headline — "piano-led 4-chord-plus cycles with 7ths, 9ths and passing chords — the antithesis of the 2-chord vamp… real cadences, secondary dominants, and modulation" — so `maxChords` is 6, the families cadence, and `susOrDimProb` carries the passing chords. The kit is "live-feel, lightly-swung acoustic… with the backbeat on 2&4, ghost 16ths, played hats or ride, and hand percussion", which is a straight 72–112, a high ghost probability, a ride lane and the loosest `quantizeStrength` here. The vocal is "arranged like a horn section", so `countermelody.densityRatio` is high. ⚠ The **INFERRED** parameters are the swing amount, every drum number, and the bassline figures; the entry marks tempo/drum values as inference and is `[LOW-CONF]` on the exact band. ⚠ `confidence` is medium, mirroring the entry. ⚠ `session.bpm.mode` is **INFERRED**: the number is not stated in the entry, and it is an authored centre of gravity inside the band the entry does state. ⚠ **`session.keys` is INFERRED.** The entry's Keys line describes the harmonic grammar but names no key centre, so these values and their weights are an authored choice — no key in this set is stated in the research. ⚠ **`drums.kick.lockTo808` removed (2026-08-17, 808 gate).** This kit has no 808 — `bass808` is `null` here or in the parent it inherits — and `lockTo808` is the one parameter that says *how much of the kick the 808 follows*, so in this file it described a pairing that does not exist: `generators::drums::bass808` returns on `block.is_none()` before the value is ever read, which makes it provably dead here. Where it was NOT dead was in the artists and producers who extend this kit and author an 808 of their own: they inherited the zero, `kicks.iter().filter(|_| rng.random_bool(0.0))` kept nothing, and their sub lane was silent at every seed — `bass808::every_shipped_model_with_an_808_produces_a_playable_line` reported "no 808 at all" for 35 of them. Removing it restores the engine's documented default of 1.0 for exactly those children and changes nothing here. ⚠ No researched claim moved: this kit's own statement about the 808 is the `bass808: null` beside it, and that is untouched.
